en.headline: Half-price National Day cinema tickets go on sale from 28 September
en.dek: The Hong Kong Theatres Association said 52 commercial cinemas will halve prices for all 1 October screenings, with tickets released from noon on Monday.
body: Half-price tickets for all commercial cinema screenings on National Day will go on sale from noon on Monday, 28 September, the Hong Kong Theatres Association said.

The association said 52 cinemas across the city will take part in the 1 October promotion, covering all formats and auditorium types that day. Tickets will be released in stages through box offices, cinema websites and mobile apps. Purchases at the box office will be limited to four tickets per person per transaction; online limits follow each circuit's own rules.

Association chairman Yuen Yin-man said the annual half-price day has been popular with audiences and thanked the government for supporting another edition. The association also plans to send a promotional truck and performers to Sha Tin, Mong Kok and Causeway Bay on Saturday, 26 September, to give away free popcorn.

The cinema offer is part of a wider set of National Day concessions announced by the government, which also include lucky-draw MTR single-journey tickets, free tram and selected ferry rides, and free use of some Leisure and Cultural Services Department recreation facilities on 1 October.

zh.headline: 國慶全線商業戲院半價 門票下周一中午起發售
zh.dek: 香港戲院商會公布，全港52間商業戲院10月1日所有場次半價，門票由9月28日中午起陸續開售，票房每人每次最多四張。
body: 香港戲院商會公布，全港52間商業戲院將於國慶日為所有場次提供半價戲票，門票由9月28日（下周一）中午12時起，在各大戲院票房、院線網站及手機應用程式陸續發售。
商會指優惠不限放映格式或影院類型。戲院票房購票每人每次最多可買4張；網上購票數量則按各院線限制。
商會理事長袁彥文表示，「10.1半價睇好戲」一直受市民歡迎，並感謝政府支持再辦。商會亦會於本周六（26日）安排宣傳車及藝人，在沙田、旺角及銅鑼灣派發免費爆谷。
戲院半價屬政府公布的一連串國慶禮遇之一，當日另有港鐵抽獎電子單程票、全線電車及部分渡輪免費乘搭，以及康文署部分收費康樂設施免費開放。
